name: @justeattakeaway/pie-code-connect
description: Figma Code Connect templates and configuration files for PIE web components

scripts.publish-components:web: yarn build:web && yarn figma connect publish -c ./config/figma-web-components-batch.config.json
scripts.publish-components:react: yarn build:react && yarn figma connect publish -c ./config/figma-react-components-batch.config.json
scripts.publish-components:vue: yarn build:vue && yarn figma connect publish -c ./config/figma-vue-components-batch.config.json
scripts.publish-components:all: yarn publish-components:web && yarn publish-components:react && yarn publish-components:vue
scripts.publish-icons:web: COMPONENT_PREFIX=icons- yarn build:web && yarn figma connect publish -c ./config/figma-icons-web.config.json
scripts.publish-icons:react: COMPONENT_PREFIX=icons- yarn build:react && yarn figma connect publish -c ./config/figma-icons-react.config.json
scripts.publish-icons:vue: COMPONENT_PREFIX=icons- yarn build:vue && yarn figma connect publish -c ./config/figma-icons-vue.config.json
scripts.publish-icons:all: yarn publish-icons:web && yarn publish-icons:react && yarn publish-icons:vue

author: Just Eat Takeaway.com - Design System Team
